projects.title: TCL Department Tracking System
projects.summary: A departmental web application developed during internship to support eCommerce workflows including product feedback, tracking, content upload schedules, and role-specific features.
projects.overview: Developed during my internship at TCL Sun Inc., this departmental web application supports eCommerce workflows for the company's eCommerce Department. The system includes product feedback management, order tracking, content upload scheduling, and role-specific features for different departments.
projects.challenge: The main challenge was translating non-technical business requirements from department personnel into a functional web application while working within the constraints of an enterprise environment.
projects.approach: I collaborated closely with department personnel to gather requirements, implemented features iteratively based on user feedback, and integrated with the existing MongoDB database to ensure data consistency.
projects.outcome: The application successfully streamlined departmental workflows, improved data management efficiency, and was well-received by department personnel for its usability and reliability.
features: Order tracking dashboard for eCommerce operations
Role-based access control for different departments
MongoDB database integration for data persistence
Responsive web interface built with Vue.js

projects.title: eModulo
projects.summary: A web-based object-oriented programming learning module with integrated game features for learning activities.
projects.overview: eModulo is a capstone project developed as a web-based object-oriented programming learning module. The application incorporates game mechanics and interactive features to make learning programming concepts engaging for students.

projects.title: Open Public Access Catalog
projects.summary: An online cataloging system for libraries, enabling users to search and browse library collections.
projects.overview: The Open Public Access Catalog (OPAC) is a web-based library management system that allows users to search and browse library collections online. The system provides an intuitive interface for library patrons to find books, journals, and other resources.

projects.title: Point of Sale System
projects.summary: A point-of-sale application to support sales transactions and business workflows for retail environments.
projects.overview: This Point of Sale (POS) system is designed to support sales transactions and related business workflows. The application provides an intuitive interface for processing sales, managing products, and tracking transactions in retail environments.

projects.title: Finance Tracker
projects.summary: A personal finance tracking web application for organizing and monitoring financial transactions.
projects.overview: The Finance Tracker is a web application designed to help users track and organize their financial transactions. The app provides a dashboard view for monitoring spending patterns, categorizing transactions, and visualizing financial data.

projects.title: Real-time Chat App
projects.summary: A real-time chat application using websockets for instant messaging.
projects.overview: A real-time chat application built with websockets to support instant messaging between users. The app provides a clean interface for sending and receiving messages with real-time updates.

projects.title: Next.js Dashboard
projects.summary: A dashboard built with Next.js showcasing server-side rendering capabilities.
projects.overview: A dashboard application built with Next.js that demonstrates server-side rendering capabilities. The project showcases modern React development patterns and performance optimizations.

projects.title: Multivariate Linear Regression with Python
projects.summary: A Python implementation of multivariate linear regression for predictive modeling with multiple features.
projects.overview: This project implements multivariate linear regression using Python, a statistical method for modeling relationships between a dependent variable and multiple independent variables. The implementation includes data preprocessing, model training, and prediction capabilities.

projects.title: Linear Regression with Python
projects.summary: A simple linear regression example in Python, demonstrating the fundamentals of linear modeling.
projects.overview: This project implements simple linear regression using Python, demonstrating the fundamental statistical method for modeling the relationship between a dependent variable and a single independent variable. The implementation includes data visualization and model evaluation.

projects.title: Face Detection
projects.summary: A computer vision project for detecting human faces in images using OpenCV.
projects.overview: This face detection project uses OpenCV to identify and locate human faces within digital images. The implementation leverages pre-trained Haar cascades for real-time face detection, demonstrating fundamental computer vision techniques.

projects.title: Document Scanner
projects.summary: A document scanning application that uses computer vision to capture and enhance document images.
projects.overview: This document scanner application uses OpenCV to detect document edges, apply perspective correction, and enhance document images for better readability. The implementation includes edge detection, contour extraction, and image processing techniques.

projects.title: Detecting Fake News
projects.summary: A machine learning project for detecting fake news articles using natural language processing.
projects.overview: This project uses machine learning and natural language processing to classify news articles as real or fake. The implementation trains a classification model on a dataset of labeled news articles and evaluates its performance using standard metrics.

projects.title: First Machine Learning
projects.summary: An introductory machine learning project exploring fundamental concepts and algorithms.
projects.overview: This introductory machine learning project explores fundamental concepts and algorithms in the field. The implementation demonstrates the basic workflow of data loading, model training, and evaluation using Python.
